conflicts.description: The Laves phase was observed in the as-cast and heat-treated samples experimentally, but it is absent in the calculated equilibrium phase fractions at 1000 °C; it is present in Scheil solidification simulations.
claims: Laves phase is present in as-cast and heat-treated samples (experimental)
Laves phase is absent in calculated equilibrium phase fractions at 1000 °C (thermodynamic calculation)

evidence.quote: It should be pointed out that this Laves phase is present in Scheil solidification simulations for both alloys, which corroborates its presence in the as-cast alloys as previously shown. Thus, its absence in the calculated equilibrium data might mean either its metastability in the microstructure of the HT alloys or inaccuracy of the thermodynamic database.
